title: Symmetric monotone odd Boolean functions
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be invariant under every permutation of its coordinates, monotone in the coordinatewise order, and odd, meaning $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for every input $x$. Then $n$ is odd and $f$ is the majority function: its value is the sign of the sum of the coordinates, with a nonnegative sum assigned value $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
